summary: Official, installable Storyboard View plugin. It is not bundled or preloaded, owns draft structure, and contributes no Generator.
context_hints: The plugin id is clash.storyboard and its only contribution is views/storyboard.json
This package is registered in the official Marketplace catalog but intentionally absent from BUNDLED_PLUGINS; users activate it explicitly
View material slots may contain many Project Asset candidates and one selected candidate
Generated candidates must come from a native Generator Output Commit; this plugin never executes generation

subdirectories.views: Declarative View definitions and initial state.
subdirectories.src: Generator-free stdio packaging entrypoint and package tests.

key_files.manifest.json: Versioned executable package with one View contribution.
key_files.views/storyboard.json: Four-section Storyboard definition and empty initial state.
